market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. US-Iran conflict sustains oil at $86+, rate-hike expectations pressure equities and crypto. September seasonality adds headwind. Energy outperforms; tech/growth under pressure. Yen intervention risk adds FX volatility. Watch August jobs data as key catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex supercycle (Meta $60B, Anthropic IPO) drives structural demand for power, materials, and semiconductors. Permian gas multi-year cycle supports energy. US debt trajectory is the primary long-term overhang. Consumer shift (estate sales, generational change) creates sector rotation opportunities. Chile risk-on and India MSCI flows signal EM recovery.
